title: 第25章 皇后真的要和我双修第25章 皇后真的要和我双修
content_zh:
前往皇城的途中，我乘坐的是由飞行灵宠拖拽的代步銮驾。
我还没琢磨出稳妥的应对之法，銮驾已然抵达皇城城门。
我能想到的唯一脱身办法，就是劫持皇后做人质。
可这招在修炼文明里，显然行不通。
修炼文明向来以家族传承为根本，血脉是立足的根基，皇权不过是家族势力的延伸罢了。
另外，修炼文明中，地位高低全靠修炼层次衡量。
皇后尚且年轻，修为定然高不到哪里去，在家族里也算不上核心人物。
就算劫持了她，家族转眼就能选出新的皇后，根本起不到人质该有的作用。
只能走一步看一步了。
我只能祈祷预感梦是准的，否则这趟皇城之行，怕是十死无生。
他们是“请”我来的，态度恭敬得很，俨然一副尊师重道的模样。
至少明面上，他们不会立刻对我下杀手。
人少的地方绝对不能去。
可双修这种事，又没法在大庭广众之下进行。
这可如何是好？
……
来时我看过皇城的地图，眼前这片宫殿群，分明就是皇后的寝宫区域。
难道皇帝请我来，真的是要我与皇后双修？
不太可能。
或许这一切都是做样子，说不定我一踏进那扇门，就会被直接拉去凝练“导师丹”。

凝练“导师丹”的过程，我特意研究过，理论上来说，只要能固守精元，就不会被凝练成丹。
可他们要是用药物迷惑我的神志，我就彻底无力反抗了。
四周越来越安静。
好在，淑蓝她们一直守在我身边。
这意味着，对方还没到动手的时候。
终于，我踏进了那扇门。
里面居然是一间宽敞的浴室。
侍女上前示意，让淑蓝她们伺候我沐浴。
“启元仪式”前要沐浴，凝练“导师丹”前，同样需要沐浴。
而且凝练“导师丹”前，通常是药浴，目的是洗去凡尘浊气，让精元变得纯粹。
这浴池里的水，果然飘着浓浓的药香，香气沁入肌肤，让人血脉偾张，有种洗髓伐骨的舒爽感。
浴室左右两侧，各站着一组18胞胎，分别穿着绿色和黄色的衣裙。
她们眼神交错，显然是在互相监督，防止出现纰漏。
我通过“虚脉”连通了她们的眼睛，从她们的视角来看，确实是在互相锁定彼此。
这时，一位侍女走上前来，递上了两枚丹药。
其中一枚我很熟悉，正是“助基丹”。
另一枚个头稍大一些，看着倒像是“导师丹”！
一瞬间，我想到了一种可能。
“导师丹”通常一次会凝练出两枚，药效完全相同。
其中一枚，自然是上一任皇帝服用了；另一枚给我吃，相当于把这份传承交到我手上。

之后再把我凝练成两枚“导师丹”，一枚给现任皇帝服用，另一枚继续传承下去，如此循环往复。
这样一来，“导师丹”的药效就会越来越强。
我根本没有选择的余地，刚犹豫了一下，侍女就直接把两枚丹药塞进了我口中。
奇怪的是，两枚丹药并未在口中化开，而是径直滑入了胃里。
content_en:
On the way to the Imperial City, I took a transportation vehicle dragged by a flying spiritual pet.
Before I could figure out a safe way to deal with it, Luan Jia had already arrived at the gate of the imperial city.
The only way I can think of to escape is to take the queen hostage.
But this trick obviously doesn't work in the cultivation civilization.
Cultivation civilization has always been based on family inheritance, bloodline is the foundation, and imperial power is just an extension of family power.
In addition, in the cultivation civilization, status is measured entirely by the level of cultivation.
The queen is still young, her cultivation level is certainly not high, and she is not considered a core figure in the family.
Even if she is kidnapped, the family can choose a new queen in a blink of an eye, which will not play the role that a hostage should have.
We can only take one step at a time.
I can only pray that the premonition dream is accurate, otherwise this trip to the imperial city will probably be a dead end.
They "invited" me to come, and their attitude was very respectful, as if they respected their teachers.
At least on the surface, they won't kill me right away.
Never go to a place with few people.
But dual cultivation cannot be done in public.
What should I do?
…
I had seen a map of the imperial city when I came here, and the palace complex in front of me was clearly the queen's bedroom area.
Could it be that when the emperor invited me here, he really wanted me and the queen to cultivate together?
Not likely.
Maybe this is all just an act, maybe as soon as I step through the door, I will be pulled directly to condense the "Mentor Pill".
I have specifically studied the process of condensing the "Mentor Pill". Theoretically speaking, as long as you can stick to the essence, it will not be condensed into a pill.
But if they use drugs to confuse my mind, I will be completely unable to resist.
It was getting quieter and quieter all around.
Fortunately, Shulan and the others have always been by my side.
This means that the other party has not yet reached the time to take action.
Finally, I stepped through the door.
Inside is actually a spacious bathroom.
The maid stepped forward and asked Shulan and others to wait for me to take a bath.
It is necessary to bathe before the "Ritual Ceremony", and it is also necessary to bathe before condensing the "Teacher Pill".
Moreover, before condensing the "Teacher Pill", there is usually a medicinal bath, with the purpose of washing away the turbid air of the world and making the essence pure.
The water in this bathtub is indeed filled with a strong medicinal fragrance. The fragrance penetrates into the skin, making people's blood flow and giving them a refreshing feeling of cleansing the marrow and cutting down the bones.
On the left and right sides of the bathroom, there are a group of 18 twins standing on each side, wearing green and yellow dresses respectively.
Their eyes intertwined, obviously supervising each other to prevent mistakes.
I connected their eyes through the "Void Vein", and from their perspective, they were indeed locking each other.
At this time, a maid came forward and handed over two pills.
One of them is very familiar to me, it is "Zhuji Dan".
The other one is slightly larger and looks like a "mentor pill"!
For a moment, I thought of a possibility.
"Teacher Pills" are usually condensed into two pills at a time, and they have exactly the same effect.
One of them was naturally taken by the previous emperor; giving the other to me is equivalent to handing this inheritance into my hands.
After that, I will be condensed into two "mentor pills", one will be given to the current emperor, and the other will continue to be passed down, and so on.
In this way, the efficacy of the "Mentor Pill" will become stronger and stronger.
I had no choice at all. I hesitated for a moment before the maid directly stuffed two pills into my mouth.
Strangely, the two pills did not melt in the mouth, but slipped straight into the stomach.
